title: Hartford, CT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hartford, CT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hartford is a city in CT with a population of 121,000. Insurance capital of America with historic architecture, the Mark Twain House, and riverfront. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.4.
